title: Fulfill-a-Wish Kits
summary: The CSR team personally delivered customized 'Fulfill-a-Wish' kits to children.
description: The CSR team visited a partner organization to personally deliver customized “Fulfill-a-Wish” kits to children. Designed around each child’s wishes, the activity created moments of joy, trust, and emotional connection, reinforcing the power of compassion in action.
